speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.

speaker: king-of-jericho
name: The king of Jericho
text: Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.

speaker: rahab
name: Rahab
text: Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

speaker: rahab
text: At dusk, when the gate was about to close, the men went out, and I do not know which way they went. Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!

speaker: rahab
text: I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.

speaker: rahab
text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom you devoted to destruction.

speaker: rahab
text: When we heard this, our hearts melted and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

speaker: rahab
text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

speaker: rahab
text: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.

speaker: two-spies
name: Two spies
text: Our lives for your lives!

speaker: two-spies
text: If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.

speaker: rahab
text: Go to the hill country,

speaker: rahab
text: so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.

speaker: two-spies
text: We will not be bound by this oath you made us swear

speaker: two-spies
text: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

speaker: two-spies
text: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.

speaker: two-spies
text: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.

speaker: rahab
text: Let it be as you say,

speaker: two-spies
text: The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands,

speaker: two-spies
text: Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.

speaker: officers
name: Officers
text: When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.

speaker: officers
text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

speaker: joshua
text: Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.

speaker: god
text: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.’

speaker: joshua
text: When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.

speaker: joshua
text: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

speaker: joshua
text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go ahead of you into the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

speaker: joshua
text: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

speaker: god
text: and command them: ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.’

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.

speaker: joshua
text: Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel,

speaker: joshua
text: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’

speaker: children
name: Children
text: What do these stones mean to you?

speaker: joshua
text: you are to tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.’ Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites forever.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.

speaker: god
text: Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Come up from the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’

speaker: children
text: What is the meaning of these stones?

speaker: joshua
text: you are to tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’

speaker: israelites
text: Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.

speaker: joshua
text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, just as He did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over.

speaker: joshua
text: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, and so that you may always fear the LORD your God.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again.

speaker: god
text: Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Are You for us or for our enemies?

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
name: Commander of the LORD’s army
text: Neither,

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
text: I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.

speaker: joshua
text: What does my Lord have to say to His servant?

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
text: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.
tag: The Commander of the LORD’s army
